categories.notes: Three Berlin FIDI affiliates were evaluated. Each official FIDI page supplies FAIM status and an expiry year, but none exposes the required membership/accreditation number. All three are therefore rejected under the user-specified ID+expiry gate.

categories.register: Rechtsanwaltskammer Berlin / BRAK official lawyer register
categories.notes: Two Berlin migration-law firms identifiable in official RAK Berlin publications were evaluated. The public RAK/BRAK search interfaces do not provide a stable provider-specific registry page exposing both membership ID and expiry for these candidates; both remain re-sourcing items.

categories.register: BaFin (official account comparison / institution supervision context)
categories.notes: Three Berlin-relevant banks were evaluated on official BaFin account-comparison pages. Those pages identify the regulated provider but do not expose both a qualifying licence/registration number and expiry; all three are rejected under the strict schema.

sources.source_name: BaFin Kontenvergleich — Berliner Sparkasse Giro Individual

policy.acceptance_gate: A provider is accepted only when an official registry/accreditation page proves the provider and supplies both accreditation/membership number and accreditation expiry. No inference from page IDs, product IDs, brand names, or certification names is permitted.

honesty_notes: No provider met the complete accreditation_number + accreditation_expiry gate, so providers.csv intentionally contains only its required header and zero data rows.
FIDI pages for AGS, Hertling, and Hasenkamp publish FAIM status and expiry years but no membership/accreditation number; those facts were preserved in rejects.csv without inventing an ID.

EuRA Berlin relocation providers were not promoted as mover substitutes because the pages reviewed did not expose a membership ID and expiry and several are destination/immigration service firms rather than removal companies.

RAK Berlin and the BRAK nationwide official lawyer register are interactive; the publicly retrievable materials used here did not yield a stable provider-specific registry record containing both membership number and expiry. The two chamber-published migration-law firms therefore remain rejects for re-sourcing.
BaFin account-comparison record keys were not treated as bank licence/registration numbers. BaFin pages reviewed did not show a licence expiry, so all banking candidates remain rejects.
No websites, accreditation IDs, or expiries were inferred or fabricated. Blank fields are deliberate.
